The dialogue presents a focused clinical evaluation of a 3-month history of right thumb and wrist pain radiating to the elbow in a postpartum patient—likely a new mother given the symptom trigger of holding her infant. **Clinical Summary:**  
A 3-month history of right-sided radial wrist and thumb pain radiating proximally to the elbow, exacerbated specifically by gripping and lifting (notably holding an infant), with no associated paresthesias, weakness, or local inflammatory signs. **Differential Considerations Under Investigation:**  
- **First carpometacarpal (CMC) joint osteoarthritis** — assessed via X-ray (AP/lateral) and MRI.
